dedupe_keys.name: timber processing sites gb forestry commission

description: This Forestry Commission dataset gives point locations of timber processing sites across Great Britain (national coverage), including sawmills and board, pellet, bark and fencing manufacturers. The feature service held 268 sites on 26 September 2026, with fields for category, company name, site name, postcode and website. It was compiled for plant health work, such as tracing where timber moves during pest outbreaks, and the provider says it only includes sites collected for that purpose, is not a complete inventory of such businesses and has incomplete attributes. It is published under the Open Government Licence v3.0 through the Forestry Commission open data portal (ArcGIS feature service, with the usual hub downloads) and was created in June 2016 with no updates planned. Caveats: incomplete and dated; many site names and websites are blank. For simulation it locates the wood processing nodes of the forestry supply chain, useful for pest spread and quarantine scenarios, biomass fuel supply and the effect of storm damage on timber flows. Related catalogue records include BGS BritPits and the UK mineral processing facilities dataset for other raw material chains.
